name: get_language
evidence: EBOOT 0x54928: calls a getter then `lbu`+`andi 7` — a 3-bit field in a settings byte; the very next function (0x549A0) is the matching setter (mask/or/sb). rel_html_view's func_0000039C maps its result 0..5 onto SDK language ids, and the strTbl_%c.bin / all_%c.ehp / %c.gim filename pattern across a dozen modules is that same letter. 334 call sites.

name: get_button_code
evidence: EBOOT 0x305D4: returns one of two ADJACENT halfwords (globals 0xE74E4 / 0xE74E6) chosen by `arg == 1`. rel_html_view compares the arg-0 result against 0x2000 = PSP_CTRL_CIRCLE to set pspUtilityDialogCommon.buttonSwap, whose documented meaning is `1 when X is the accept button` — so the pair is the confirm/cancel button masks and arg 0 selects confirm. 288 call sites.

name: frame_sync
evidence: EBOOT 0x47268: a two-call wrapper. First 0x57280 updates a timer object at 0x560F94 (a sibling function reads it via sceRtcGetCurrentTick), then 0x18750 tail-calls sceKernelWakeupThread on a global thread id. Called exactly once per main-loop iteration in both rel_movie_viewer and rel_html_view. 172 call sites. Name is an inference from behaviour, not a proven symbol.
